blocks.text: If you are using OAuth enrollment, use this page to associate the App Connector with the Oauth enrollment tokens and groups. To learn more, see Understanding Oauth Enrollment. For a complete list of ranges and limits per feature, see Ranges & Limitations.

Oauth enrollment is available for supported Zscaler virtual machine (VM) images. If you want to use an OAuth enrollment token to enroll an App Connector, get the enrollment token from the App Connector's virtual serial console before you begin. To learn more, see App Connector Deployment Guides for Supported Platforms.

If you want to use a provisioning key to enroll an App Connector, create an App Connector group and a provisioning key, and add the provisioning key to the App Connector's console. You do not need to add an App Connector on the Add App Connectors page.
To add a new App Connector:

blocks.item: Go to Private Access > Private Infrastructure > App Connectors.
The Add App Connectors page appears.
On the Add App Connectors page:

App Connector Group: Select an existing App Connector group from the Group drop-down menu. If a signing certificate is associated with the App Connector group, it appears under Signing Certificate. Otherwise, select a signing certificate from the drop-down menu.

Enrollment Tokens: Enter up to 20 OAuth 2.0 enrollment tokens that you copied from the App Connector virtual serial console to use for connecting App Connectors in the App Connector group. Tokens are valid for 2 hours.
You can also enroll App Connectors using provisioning keys. To learn more, see About App Connector Provisioning Keys.
